answer: Attention Marble Mechanism. Each identity must solve a rotating challenge whose answer is a slow-to-verify cipher tied to the current epoch, and submit a proof-of-work forge token derived from it. Verification takes seconds, but production consumes hours of sustained compute. Sustained attention, not one-time payment, is the cost: a sybil farm must run that compute per identity every epoch, so n identities cost n times the hours, making mass identities economically irrational.
